description: PostgreSQL business analysis. Filters apply to score density and filtered TPS; the category fraud-share bar plot uses the latest 1,000 matching transactions. Includes a merchant exposure chart.

panels.title: Score density (most recent 1,000 filtered transactions)
panels.description: Filtered density distribution of probability scores. The query uses only the latest 1,000 rows matching the selected state and merchant.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT score
    FROM scores
    WHERE us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})
      AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1000
), buckets AS (
    SELECT width_bucket(score, 0.0, 1.000001, 20) AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (bucket::text || ' / 20') AS score_bucket,
       n::double precision / NULLIF(SUM(n) OVER (), 0) AS density
FROM buckets
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Filtered TPS (transactions per second)
panels.description: Minute counts are divided by 60 to display average transactions per second for the selected state and merchant filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'), COUNT(*)::double precision / 60.0 AS tps
FROM scores
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})
  AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fraud share by product category — last 1,000 matching transactions
panels.description: Required category bar plot. The average fraud flag is calculated over the latest 1,000 filtered transactions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_1000 AS (
    SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag
    FROM scores
    WHERE us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})
      AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1000
)
SELECT cat_id,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(fraud_flag::numeric), 2) AS fraud_share_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS transactions
FROM latest_1000
GROUP BY cat_id
ORDER BY fraud_share_pct DESC

panels.title: Flagged transaction amount by merchant — last 24 hours
panels.description: Additional business metric: nominal amount of transactions flagged as fraud, grouped by merchant for the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT merch,
       ROUND(SUM(transaction_amount * fraud_flag)::numeric, 2) AS flagged_amount
FROM scores
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})
  AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})
GROUP BY merch
ORDER BY flagged_amount DESC
LIMIT 10
